messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reported a regression where their PDF summarization toolcall keeps falling back to the general text summarizer and returning a short text instead of structured PDF output. Happening intermittently since yesterday 23:00 UTC. Trace: trace-id=tr-9f3a1b

sam_py_sdk: Can you paste the original error/log from the gateway?

support-bot: Gateway request 2468101212 logged: selector_decision=TEXT_SUMMARY_V1 reason=tool_schema_mismatch code=400 latency=234ms

maria_support: From the gateway logs (sanitized):
```
raw_request.body = {
  "tool": "pdf_summarize",
  "args": {
    "attachment": "\"SGVsbG8sIHBkZiBkYXRhX2V4YW1wbGU=\"",
    "page_range": "1-3"
  }
}
validator.error = "attachment: expected bytes, got string"
```

devon_ts_sdk: wait that looks like a quoted base64 string: \"\"SGV...=\"\" — double-quoted inside the JSON string. Which SDK version are they on?

maria_support: Customer says TS SDK 2.4.1 for server, Python client 1.7.0 for their batch worker. They say Node calls succeed, Python calls fail.

sam_py_sdk: I suspect double-encoding on the Python side: our Python SDK historically base64-encodes bytes and then JSON-encodes again; if a caller pre-encodes AND we encode again we can end up with an extra layer of quotes. Quick repro from the customer attached:
```python
# python client (repro)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=...)
b64 = base64.b64encode(open("doc.pdf","rb").read()).decode()
# they passed the string directly
c.call_tool("pdf_summarize", {"attachment": b64, "page_range": "1-3"})
```

sam_py_sdk: That will cause the SDK to treat the str as "already encoded" but an internal branch does: json.dumps({"attachment": b64}) which results in the string value with quotes preserved in the serialized form. If we also have an encode-bytes path that wraps again the payload you can end up sending a payload where the attachment value is a JSON string containing quotes.

devon_ts_sdk: On Node side we typically pass Buffer and the TS SDK sends raw bytes frame or proper base64 without extra quotes, so it matches schema.

maria_support: Customer also reported higher latency (retries) because selector fell back and they retried at app layer. Billing impact small but they were charged for two attempts.

lee_eng-platform: Need repro we can run internally. @sam_py_sdk can you produce a minimized script showing exact outgoing HTTP body captured? Also which encoder path in py SDK 1.7.0 is used?

sam_py_sdk: Minimal outgoing body we captured from their support dump:
```
POST /v1/call_tool
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "tool": "pdf_summarize",
  "args": {
    "attachment": "\"SGVsbG8sIHBkZiBkYXRhX2V4YW1wbGU=\"",
    "page_range": "1-3"
  }
}
```
That outer value has literal quotes in it (notice \"...\"). Server validator interprets the value as a normal string not bytes -> schema mismatch -> selector uses fallback.

olivia_eng-ml: This explains tool selection behavior — tool selector runs a light schema validation before committing. If required field types mismatch we route to a compatibility hub which picks a safer text-only tool.

lee_eng-platform: Action items: (1) eng-platform to patch Python SDK quick check to avoid double-wrapping base64 if caller already passes a str that matches base64 regex; (2) eng-ml to make selector tolerant for quoted base64 strings for a short window (preprocessor strip outer quotes) to reduce fallout; (3) support to provide customer workaround.

devon_ts_sdk: I'll add a unit test to TS client to ensure Buffer vs base64 string behavior remains consistent.

maria_support: Customer workaround provided: ensure they pass raw bytes to Python SDK instead of pre-encoding:
```python
with open("doc.pdf","rb") as f:
    content = f.read()
c.call_tool("pdf_summarize", {"attachment": content, "page_range":"1-3"})
```
They verified this works.

sam_py_sdk: Temporary patch suggestion for SDK 1.7.x (to ship as 1.7.1): before serializing, run: if isinstance(val, str) and BASE64_RE.match(val) and val.startswith('"') and val.endswith('"'): val = val[1:-1]  # strip accidental extra quotes. Not perfect but low risk.

lee_eng-platform: @olivia_eng-ml please advise if selector change is safe for quick deploy. If yes, we'll feature-flag it and roll to prod for 48h.

olivia_eng-ml: Ok to add a tolerant preprocessor that strips a single pair of surrounding quotes iff inner content matches base64 and field expected type is bytes. Flagged. We'll monitor false positives.

maria_support: Customer accepted workaround and asked for ETA on SDK patch. Can we give them a patch ETA?

sam_py_sdk: Targeting hotfix 1.7.1 in next 24h. Will open PR shortly.

lee_eng-platform: I'll own selector feature-flag rollout. Creating ENG-PLATFORM ticket EP-6342 and linking traces (tr-9f3a1b).

maria_support: Thanks all — marking as customer-updated and will follow up when 1.7.1 and selector fix are live. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Ticket EP-6342 created and assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml, eng-sdk. Priority: P2.
